method: Sequential local measurements, optimized Rust binaries and committed production web assets; warm caches; five samples per scenario.
notes: API harness copied unchanged into isolated source snapshots; only benchmark registration and budget files added to old snapshots.
api-regressed.json was measured with --compare api-lock-fixed.json and correctly exited 1 for small read and mixed bursts.
frontend-final.json measures the existing d2df382 frontend assets; this follow-up changes only backend production code.
backend-before.json is the earlier same-machine measurement of the exact 5694368 revision.
These local reports are evidence, not portable absolute CI thresholds.
